title: Narrow string substring assignment
summary: Recovered Game.exe VA 0x415fe0..0x4160f7, RVA 90080, 279 bytes as a readable genuine thiscall member. Source, offset and count are stack arguments; EAX returns this and RET removes 12 bytes. The i386 object has a 16-byte inline/pointer union, length at +16 and capacity at +20; capacity >=16 selects heap. Unsigned offset validation precedes mutation, count clamps to the remaining source. Self-assignment publishes the truncated length and terminator before calling original erase(0,offset). Distinct assignment rejects selected length UINT_MAX, grows only when needed, copies selected bytes with memcpy semantics, publishes length and writes NUL. Empty assignment preserves capacity and all storage except byte zero. Caller evidence includes pointer alias delegation at 0x416564/0x41657a, full copies at 0x43d03e/0x43d2bd and initialized construction at 0x440ab9. Direct original instructions, error strings and imports inspected. Accepted target and erase spans independently compared equal to immutable Game.exe. No matching-source claim.
test_description: GCC i386 freestanding build with the specified fixed flags plus -Wall -Wextra -Werror passes. Matrix covers capacities 0,7,15,16,31,63; all lengths and valid substring offsets through those capacities; counts 0,1,2,7,15,16,31,63,64,UINT_MAX-1,UINT_MAX; self and distinct inline/heap combinations without growth. Embedded NULs, high bytes, poisoned unused storage and deliberately nonzero old terminators detect exact writes. Assertions compare return identity, length, capacity, pointer identity, entire objects, unused union bytes, full backing buffers, guards, source immutability and independent expected results. Local mapped execution compares every non-growth matrix case directly against original_narrow_assign_substring, with actual accepted original_narrow_erase and C++ doubles only for unavailable CRT copy/move/error dependencies. Invalid offsets length+1 and UINT_MAX, both self and distinct, plus selected length UINT_MAX test error dispatch before mutation with builtin nonlocal transfer. Controlled growth checks cover inline/heap relocation and failure, verifying requested count, old length, copy ordering, final metadata, terminator, old storage and source preservation. A second execution without dependency mappings passes and reports its reduced original-path comparisons explicitly. Both accepted assembly spans were linked at their original VAs and byte-compared to Game.exe (279 and 155 bytes).
known_limits: Original growth at 0x416890 requires Windows FS exception state, allocation/free imports, cookie and EH metadata. It is not executed or recovered here. The grow integration member remains external; test.cpp supplies a controlled relocation/failure double, not the original allocation policy or Windows exception semantics.

Full local non-growth differential execution maps test-only .oracle_copy to 0x8f8d66 and .oracle_iat to 0x92d168. The copy double replaces the unavailable memcpy import thunk; IAT entries intercept nonreturning errors and memmove. These are dependency doubles, not accepted original CRT implementations. No original target instructions are replaced.

The trusted linker is not assumed to place optional dependency sections. Tests detect their addresses. Without mapping they directly compare original self ranges requiring no memmove and distinct empty ranges; they independently check C++ distinct copies, growth dispatch and error boundaries. Original nonempty distinct copies, nonempty self-prefix shifts and errors require the mapped dependencies for direct differential execution.

Original CRT exception construction and Windows unwinding are not recovered. Port hooks must not return from out-of-range or length-error dispatch and must provide equivalent memcpy, erase and growth contracts.

Distinct objects sharing overlapping backing storage retain the original memcpy contract; no new overlap guarantee is added. Corrupt metadata, invalid pointers and impossible extents are not assigned portable behavior. Finite backed tests do not exhaust uint32_t lengths.

The layout and calling convention describe i386. A 64-bit port must adapt pointer layout intentionally. Implementation uses C++11 syntax and guarded compiler ABI annotations. Optional pinned MSVC helper was absent locally; native MSVC2013 checks remain with the coordinator. Behavior validation earns no byte-matching credit.
